name: Recreational Vehicle
description: A motor vehicle, minibikes included, designed to travel over unimproved terrain that the DMV has found unsuitable for the public way and ineligible for road registration, which is where an off-road electric dirt bike lands.

restrictions.rule: Designed to travel over unimproved terrain and not eligible for road registration; no limit on motor power or speed
Registered with the Department of Environmental Management for $25 a year, with a reflective identification number displayed
First-time buyers and riders under 16 must complete a safety course, and carry proof of it when riding off private property
Riders and passengers must wear an approved helmet with a face guard
Kept off roadways, shoulders and the rest of the highway right of way except to cross directly, and never within an interstate or freeway right of way
Riders under 16 may not cross a state highway, and riders 16 or 17 may cross only while carrying a driver's license
On state parks and other DEM land, an off-road vehicle must be street-registered and keep to designated areas or trails at designated times
The motorcycle license law doesn't apply to it, and the DMV doesn't register it
